Subject: Meridian case study — initial draft for fact-check + quote

Hi Lena / Dr. Cho —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Attached is the draft case study (v2) we promised after the interview: meridian-draft-case-study-v2.docx. The doc includes a short customer quote pulled from the transcript and a metrics table we built from the usage dashboard.

Could you: 1) confirm the technical metrics in the table (we estimated average inference latency at P95 = 240ms based on your deployment spike window), and 2) sign off on the final quote on page 2 so we can schedule a publish for the 22nd?

If you want edits, please mark up the doc or reply with inline suggestions. I'll coordinate legal if you prefer us to send a shorter version for compliance.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0193

Attachment: meridian-draft-case-study-v2.docx (docx, 245 KB)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Dr. Samuel Cho <sam.cho@meridianhealth.com>, Meridian Legal <legal@meridianhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian case study — initial draft for fact-check + quote

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the draft. Quick read-through from my side: overall this looks good. A few factual items we need corrected:
- The P95 latency you list (240ms) is for our internal test cluster. Production P95 during business hours is closer to 310ms on average (we typically report ~300–320).
- We do not share raw user counts. Could you switch the absolute user numbers to ranges (e.g., 50k–75k weekly active users) or percentages?

On the customer quote attributed to Dr. Cho, he suggested a softer phrasing: change “instant insights” to “faster clinical insights at scale.” I've marked up the document and attached a redline.

Lena
Director, Digital Transformation
Meridian Health

Attachment: meridian-draft-case-study-v2_Lena-redlines.docx (docx, 78 KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Meridian case study — initial draft for fact-check + quote

Hi Lena —

Thanks for the redlines and guidance. Quick notes from our side:
- We'll update the P95 to a production figure "~310ms" and add a parenthetical note that this is during weekday business-hour traffic.
- We'll convert all user counts to ranges as you suggested and remove any raw identifiers.
- Re: quote wording, we can update to “faster clinical insights at scale.” We'll send the revised PDF for final sign-off by Monday.

Looping in Monica from PR to confirm the publication cadence and Laura from Legal to track any additional review steps. Monica / Laura — do you have any constraints on imagery or patient reference language?

Best,
Stephanie

Hi all —

Thanks, Stephanie — I updated the doc per Lena's notes: P95 set to ~310ms (weekday peak), user numbers converted to ranges, and quote updated to “faster clinical insights at scale.” Also removed the small screenshot that referenced patient identifiers.

A couple of asks before we publish:
- Lena: please confirm the new quote PDF attachment (customer-quote-approval.pdf) is acceptable for the marketing page.
- Laura: can Legal confirm that the ranges + wording meet our compliance expectations? If Legal needs DocuSign for the quote we can kick that off today.

I've attached the revised export and a one-pager metrics sheet for your review. Proposed publish window: week of July 19 (we can move to July 22 if Legal needs more time).

Hi Monica / Stephanie —

The updated quote PDF looks good to me; thank you for the quick turnaround. I ran the revised language by Dr. Cho and he approved the phrasing. A couple small legal notes from our side: please remove the logo in the header (we don't permit third-party hosting with our logo) and add the following attribution sentence at the bottom: “Meridian Health retains ownership of patient data and does not share identifiable records.”

If you can send the final PDF without the logo and with the attribution, I can get a DocuSign for the marketing approval on our end.

Lena

Legal reviewed the updated PDF and the metrics sheet. Summary:
- The ranges for user counts and the shift to a production P95 number are acceptable.
- Remove the Meridian logo from any hosted marketing assets (we will host a neutral thumbnail).
